title: Going from Place to Place
editorial: Singapore’s public transit is a wonder of the world. Get your EZ-Link card at Changi airport and take the MRT (aka metro aka subway aka tube) to your hotel.
Anywhere you go, including the zoo, is a mere minutes from either an MRT station or a bus stop (the EZ-Link card works for buses too).
If the weather is pleasant, you can walk extensively as Singaporean streets are designed to protect pedestrians from the heat.
For what it’s worth, we took one Uber during our trip, so that’s an option if you’re too posh for public transportation.
